description: Replayable flows that reach each native mobile runtime screenshot in parts/runtime-mobile-observations.json. Suite Native screens expose their content to iOS accessibility as a single element (Screen.tsx renders an accessible container), so steps tap exposed testIDs or visible text located by OCR. capture-flows.ts replay runs the steps through agent-device and records each outcome here; capture-flows.ts check OCRs every capture for the arrival landmarks (runtime/flow-checks.json).

fresh-install.description: The app was uninstalled, the simulator keychain reset and the debug build reinstalled before replay (outside the app); the flow starts on the onboarding Welcome screen.

keychain-unavailable.description: The app was uninstalled, the simulator keychain reset and a copy of the debug build without entitlements installed (outside the app). Keychain access fails, so the app cannot read or create its storage encryption key and shows the native "Unable to load app data" alert at startup.

onboarded-empty.description: The setup steps were replayed after a fresh install (analytics off, biometrics skipped, trading country skipped); app data is kept between relaunches. No wallet, device or account is connected or imported.
